question: Saikhom Mirabai Chanu, who has been conferred with the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award in 2018, is a/an:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Weightlifter.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saikhom Mirabai Chanu** is an Indian weightlifter.
 
• She is the winner of the silver medal at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics in the Women's 49 kg category.
 
• She belongs to Nongpok Kakching village in Manipur's Imphal East district.
